deadline_policy: Each phase cap=min(nominal cap, global remaining-20s); outer controller leaves60s for scheduler cleanup. Later phases skip when remaining too short. Caps are not additive reservations.
interpretation: fixed5 is an explicitly nonconverged snapshot, never a full SCF timing or acceptance result
Python calls during tracing are not runtime iteration counts
Nested stage spans and multi-thread HLO durations cannot be added as walltime percentages
Independent kernel timings change fusion boundaries and cannot be added as production loop costs
Compiler memory estimates differ from sampled process RSS
GKS packed and UKS auxiliary RI are different algorithms; their ratio is not an isolated implementation comparison
Actual results take precedence over this plan; conditional phases may skip
